{{Quote|Lady Aldrete controls an information network that stretches from Alderaan to Empress Teta. Her smugglers double as observers and spies, particularly in the Deep Core. Even the Bothan SpyNet can't match her infiltration of that region.|Notru'denn, on Alya Aldrete's smuggler fleet|<ref name="Gem of Alderaan">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref>}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Alya Aldrete]] operated a '''smuggler fleet''' in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] regions. Her [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] infiltrated restricted Imperial [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and transported illicit goods whilst also gathering information and operating an [[Spy/Legends|intelligence]] network that spanned [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Aldrete allied her group with the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] rebel movement and assembled her forces into an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] for an [[Battle of Byss|attack]] on an under-construction [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]] in the [[Beshqek system]]. The smugglers and Alderaanian rebels successfully destroyed the Star Destroyer, achieving a major victory against the Empire.

==Description==
{{Quote|I have reason to believe that, among her other contacts, she has a cadre of personal smugglers who ferry illegal spice, stolen artwork, and other illicit luxuries. Every indication is that she has access to several clearance codes that would provide authorization for travel in the Deep Core.|Bail Organa, on Alya Aldrete and her smuggling network|<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />}}
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Alya Aldrete]] commanded a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]<ref name="Primer" /> of criminals,<ref name="Jaws of the Sarlacc">{{DoD|Jaws of the Sarlacc}}</ref> [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that operated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] regions of the galaxy.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|Aldrete, Alya|I|19}}</ref> The group was adept at acquiring security clearances necessary for reaching restricted [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] occupied by the Galactic Empire in the Deep Core, allowing the criminals to smuggle illegal goods to highly secure Imperial strongholds in the region. The smugglers hauled illicit goods ranging from stolen artworks to [[Spice/Legends|spice]], though their operation extended beyond just transporting contraband. Acting as [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and observers, the smugglers covertly gathered information for Aldrete, operating an information network that spanned the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

The armada was comprised of an assorted group of ragtag and aged [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including modified [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk haulers]], [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]], [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] dating from the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] galactic conflict, and at least one modified [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian Gunship]]. In spite of their worn appearance, the vessels comprised an effective fighting force, operated by some of the galaxy's most proficient [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Among the crews of the ships were [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] proficient in the modification of [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] and [[Transponder code/Legends|IFF transponders]].<ref name="Jaws of the Sarlacc" />

==History==
[[File:Alyaadrete.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lady Alya Aldrete]]
{{Quote|What I have proposed to my captains is a mission to destroy the prototype. We've got enough ships to distract its defenders, but we can't hope to beat them and destroy the ship&mdash;just survive. What we need is someone to take control of their defenses and turn them against the prototype.|Alya Aldrete, setting out her battle plan for the attack by her fleet against the Super Star Destroyer prototype|<ref name="Jaws of the Sarlacc" />}}
The smuggler fleet was assembled by Lady Aldrete during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The armada operated within the Empire's Deep Core heartlands while remaining under the radar of the Imperial regime,<ref name="Primer" /> and Aldrete used the network to map reliable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and gather information. The group's reach extended from the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to the world of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and their infiltration of the Deep Core region exceeded that of the noted [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> espionage organization.<ref name="Furry and Fury">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041216b|text=Furry and Fury}}</ref> To mask her smuggler operation and deter any potential [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] investigations into, Aldrete cultivated a public persona as a spoilt celebrity heiress with a wide media following.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

Circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Echoes of the Jedi]],'' the fourth instalment of the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, states that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. This thus indicates that ''Dawn of Defiance'' is set in circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of Alderaan sought the assistance Aldrete and her smuggler contacts with infiltrating the Imperial-occupied Deep Core world [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] to rescue the captive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]]. Aldrete agreed to provide Organa's agents with security clearances for travel to Prakith<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> and she pledged the support of her fleet to supporting the senator's [[Alderaanian Resistance]] rebel movement with [[Sarlacc Project campaign|combating]] an [[Sarlacc Project|Imperial operation]] to construct a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype|prototype Super Star Destroyer]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]].<ref name="Jaws of the Sarlacc" />

After Aldrete sent out a call for her fleet to mobilize, her whole forces gathered at a rendezvous point next to large [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] in the restricted [[Deep Core Security Zone]]. The smugglers brought with them fresh intelligence regarding the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], revealing to Aldrete that the gargantuan warship was [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] away from completion. The smuggler fleet was supplemented by the remaining vessels of an Alderaanian Resistance battle group shattered in an [[Battle of the Resurgence|Imperial attack]] several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] earlier, and number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from both groups were assembled to form the unit [[Blue Squadron (Alderaanian Resistance)|Blue Squadron]]. Aldrete took personal command of a Corellian Gunship designated as her [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] and devised with Organa a plan of attack to raid the prototype's construction site in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="Jaws of the Sarlacc" />

The smuggler armada departed for Byss and [[Battle of Byss|engaged]] the supporting Imperial fleet protecting the prototype as part of a ruse to draw out the defensive forces while agents of the rebels disabled the prototype [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The smuggler ships feigned a retreat to draw the defending fleet away but were intercepted by an Imperial [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction]] vessel. The prototype Star Destroyer then [[Precision hyperspace jump|microjumped]] into the midst of the battle, barraging the smuggler forces and forcing Aldrete's fleet to assume a defensive formation. While the smugglers overcame the Imperial interdiction ship, Blue Squadron flew inside the prototype and detonated its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]], resulting in the destruction of the Star Destroyer. The smuggler fleet then departed Byss and fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] , having achieved one of the first major victories of a resistance group against the Imperial regime.<ref name="Jaws of the Sarlacc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The smuggler fleet featured within in ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] series set within [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity and published on [[Wizards.com]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. The armada was first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of Defiance: Gamemaster Primer]]'', an outline of the ''Dawn of Defiance'' campaign written by [[Rodney Thompson]] and released on [[October 4]], [[2007]],<ref name="Primer" /> The fleet was subsequently referenced in ''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]'', the eighth ''Dawn of Defiance'' module written by [[Gary M. Sarli]] and published on [[February 5]] [[2009]],<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> Later that year, the fleet also featured in the final instalment of the series, ''[[Jaws of the Sarlacc]]'' by [[Rodney Thompson]], released on [[October 28]], 2009.<ref name="Jaws of the Sarlacc" />
